name: fiction
description: Novels and short fiction: prose narrative with characters, plot, and a fictional world.

row_fields.name: goal
row_fields.prompt: What was the driving character trying to achieve in this scene?

row_fields.name: outcome
row_fields.prompt: What changed as a result? If nothing changed, say so plainly.

brief_fields.name: logline
brief_fields.label: Logline
brief_fields.prompt: What's the book, in one or two sentences?

brief_fields.name: release_format
brief_fields.label: Release format
brief_fields.prompt: Standalone, part of a series, or serialized/episodic (chapters released individually over time, e.g. a web serial)? This changes what counts as a structural gap — a serialized chapter deliberately not resolving everything (a hook or open thread carrying to the next installment) is craft, not a defect, and shouldn't be flagged as one.

brief_fields.name: comps
brief_fields.label: Comps
brief_fields.prompt: A couple of published books it sits beside?

draft_stages.name: exploratory / partial
draft_stages.implication: Structure only. No line-level findings at all — the prose isn't real yet.

draft_stages.name: first complete draft
draft_stages.implication: Developmental focus. Line findings only if major+ or a manuscript-wide pattern.

draft_stages.name: revised
draft_stages.implication: Both layers in full, normal severity calibration.

draft_stages.name: near-submission
draft_stages.implication: Both layers, and minor findings become worth reporting.
